library.name: custom CSS
library.notes: No component library - custom React components with CSS variables

patterns.cards: 1px border var(--color-border), radius-md, hover border-color change
patterns.buttons: btn class + variant (btn-primary, btn-secondary, btn-danger, btn-success)
patterns.badges: badge class + status variant, uppercase text, small font
patterns.collapsible: expand icon (triangle), body hidden/shown, border highlight when expanded
patterns.loading: spinner animation with border-top color, loading-message text
patterns.empty: centered text with muted color, optional action button
patterns.forms: form-group with label above, full-width inputs, focus border-color change
patterns.modals: modal-overlay (backdrop) + modal (centered card max-w 500px), modal-actions for button row
patterns.workflow: workflow-actions container with workflow-status, workflow-buttons row, workflow-error for inline errors
patterns.slide-in-panel: fixed right-edge (400-420px width), full height, z-index 1000, semi-transparent overlay (rgba 0,0,0,0.3), click-overlay-to-close, Escape-to-close, slideInRight animation. Used by: ChatPanel, CommentThread. Rule: one panel open at a time.
